corporate_action_leg_one_instrument.name: corporate_action_leg_one_instrument
corporate_action_leg_one_instrument.value: (("corporate_action_legs"."security_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("corporate_action_legs"."listing_id" IS NOT NULL)::int) = 1

corporate_action_leg_ratio_shape.name: corporate_action_leg_ratio_shape
corporate_action_leg_ratio_shape.value: (("corporate_action_legs"."ratio_numerator" IS NULL) = ("corporate_action_legs"."ratio_denominator" IS NULL)) AND ("corporate_action_legs"."ratio_numerator" IS NULL OR (("corporate_action_legs"."ratio_numerator" > 0 AND "corporate_action_legs"."ratio_denominator" > 0) AND "corporate_action_legs"."ratio_numerator" NOT IN ('NaN'::real, 'Infinity'::real, '-Infinity'::real) AND "corporate_action_legs"."ratio_denominator" NOT IN ('NaN'::real, 'Infinity'::real, '-Infinity'::real)))

corporate_action_leg_cash_nonnegative.name: corporate_action_leg_cash_nonnegative
corporate_action_leg_cash_nonnegative.value: "corporate_action_legs"."cash_amount" IS NULL OR ("corporate_action_legs"."cash_amount" >= 0 AND "corporate_action_legs"."cash_amount" NOT IN ('NaN'::real, 'Infinity'::real, '-Infinity'::real))

durable_memories_scope_project_ck.name: durable_memories_scope_project_ck
durable_memories_scope_project_ck.value:
("durable_memories"."scope" = 'user' AND "durable_memories"."project_id" IS NULL)
    OR
    ("durable_memories"."scope" = 'project' AND "durable_memories"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)

exchange_holiday_early_close_shape.name: exchange_holiday_early_close_shape
exchange_holiday_early_close_shape.value: ("exchange_holidays"."status" = 'early_close' AND "exchange_holidays"."early_close_time" IS NOT NULL) OR ("exchange_holidays"."status" = 'closed' AND "exchange_holidays"."early_close_time" IS NULL)

instrument_relationships_listing_or_comp.name: instrument_relationships_listing_or_company_shape
instrument_relationships_listing_or_comp.value:
("instrument_relationships"."relationship_type" = 'succession'
        AND "instrument_relationships"."source_company_id" IS NOT NULL AND "instrument_relationships"."target_company_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "instrument_relationships"."source_listing_id" IS NULL AND "instrument_relationships"."target_listing_id" IS NULL)
      OR
      ("instrument_relationships"."relationship_type" <> 'succession'
        AND "instrument_relationships"."source_listing_id" IS NOT NULL AND "instrument_relationships"."target_listing_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "instrument_relationships"."source_company_id" IS NULL AND "instrument_relationships"."target_company_id" IS NULL)

project_artifacts_owner_context_ck.name: project_artifacts_owner_context_ck
project_artifacts_owner_context_ck.value: "project_artifacts"."project_id" IS NOT NULL OR "project_artifacts"."owning_chat_id" IS NOT NULL

project_chats_scope_project_ck.name: project_chats_scope_project_ck
project_chats_scope_project_ck.value:
("project_chats"."scope" = 'project' AND "project_chats"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)
    OR
    ("project_chats"."scope" = 'quick' AND "project_chats"."project_id" IS NULL)

user_persona_preferences_secondary_perso.name: user_persona_preferences_secondary_personas_shape
user_persona_preferences_secondary_perso.value: CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("user_persona_preferences"."secondary_personas") = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length("user_persona_preferences"."secondary_personas") <= 8 ELSE false END
